edges.label: DOE contractor custody sits outside the DoD special access program reporting regime entirely
edges.note: Atomic Energy Act Restricted Data authorities are a separate statutory classification scheme; material held under them by a DOE management and operating contractor is not reachable by the Sec. 119 reporting obligations Congress relies on. No document places UAP material under DOE authority.
